prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters, simple rounded people with big round eyes, small dot pupils and overbites, rebuilt as a stop-motion miniature: matte plasticine people with fingerprints and tiny asymmetries, felt coats loosely stitched, a real wooden doll's-house set lit by tiny practical bulbs, dust in the air. A tall city building cut open in cross-section like a doll's house, seen straight on at night, a small solid red moon above the roof. In the attic an old woman in a coat shivers by one candle in an ice blue room. At street level a cream and brick red bakery; a red crowd and a blue crowd of mixed ages and skin tones shove each other under a yellow street lamp, a police car beside them. Below, a secret basement in emerald lamplight: printing presses with simple faces painted on their sides throw banknotes into the air, gangsters in pinstripe suits play jazz, and a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat and gold chain dances. At the very bottom an orange furnace. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
